title: Export array of TextureRect breaks on startup/export
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable.mono - Reproducible in 4.6.1.stable.mono ### System information Windows 11 - Godot Mono v4.4.1.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 - Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU @ 2.70 GHz ### Issue description Given a node with an attached c# script that defines an exported array of TextureRect, the project will produce an error, either on build, or on launch when generating the .godot cache. The export will be null in the resulting build. Error on build: ``` ERROR: Failed to get property '' from node 'Control'. at: (scene/resources/packed_scene.cpp:531) ``` Error on run: ``` ERROR: System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object. at Test._Ready() in \godot-bug-test\Test.cs:line 10 at Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(godot_string_name& method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret) at Godot.CanvasItem.InvokeGodotClassMethod(godot_string_name& method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret) at Godot.Control.InvokeGodotClassMethod(godot_string_name& method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret) at Test.InvokeGodotClassMethod(godot_string_name& method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret) in \godot-bug-test\.godot\mono\temp\obj\ExportRelease\win-x64\Godot.SourceGenerators\Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptMethodsGenerator\Test_ScriptMethods.generated.cs:line 38 at Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(IntPtr godotObjectGCHandle, godot_string_name* method, godot_variant** args, Int32 argCount, godot_variant_call_error* refCallError, godot_variant* ret) at: void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (:0) ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a scene with multiple TextureRect nodes. e.g. 2. Attach the following script: ``` using Godot; public partial class Test : Control { [Export] public TextureRect[] Icons; public override void _Ready() { foreach (var icon in Icons) { GD.Print(icon.Name, icon.Texture.GetImage().ResourcePath); } } } ``` 3. Connect the TextureRect to the export. 4. Create an export preset with `Embed PCK` 5. With the .godot folder deleted, export the project. `godot --headless --export-release "TestPreset" "test_game.exe"` 6. Running the game `.\test_game.exe`, the reference to "Icons" will be give a null error. > *note*: the need for the missing .godot folder is due to building the project with a CI/CD pipeline from a fresh clone each time. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [export-bug-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25872534/export-bug-test.zip)
